description: Source code for the BlockGenerator class in Apache Spark Streaming, responsible for batching received data into blocks, managing thread-based block generation and pushing, and handling block lifecycle events.

classes.name: BlockGenerator
classes.description: Manages batching of data received by a Spark Streaming receiver into blocks, handles thread-based block creation and pushing, and manages block lifecycle states.

classes.name: BlockGeneratorListener
classes.description: Trait defining callback methods for block generation events, data addition, block push, and error handling.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the block generation and pushing threads, transitioning the generator to active state.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops data addition, block generation, and block pushing in an orderly manner.

methods.name: addData
methods.description: Adds a single data item to the current buffer.

methods.name: addDataWithCallback
methods.description: Adds data to buffer and invokes onAddData callback.

methods.name: addMultipleDataWithCallback
methods.description: Adds multiple data items atomically and invokes onAddData callback.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the generator is in active state.

methods.name: isStopped
methods.description: Checks if the generator has been stopped.

methods.name: updateCurrentBuffer
methods.description: Creates a new block from current buffer and enqueues it for pushing.

methods.name: keepPushingBlocks
methods.description: Continuously pushes blocks from the queue to the block manager until stopping condition.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Logs error and invokes onError callback.

methods.name: pushBlock
methods.description: Invokes onPushBlock callback for a block.
